units.source_text: 他和那个人行事的时候，一定得套上橡胶制品。

en.t: When he had sex with that person, he absolutely had to put on a rubber.

units.source_text: 以前他曾患过淋病，直到现在都不确定有没有痊愈。

en.t: He had once had gonorrhea, and even now he was not sure whether it had completely cleared up.

units.source_text: 虽然检查的结果都是阴性，但小便后忽地感到尿道疼痛，

en.t: Although the test results were always negative, when he suddenly felt pain in his urethra after urinating,

units.source_text: 他会赶快慌慌张张地拿了试管来看，果然还漂浮着白线头似的东西。

en.t: he would hurriedly and anxiously take up the test tube to look, and sure enough, something like white thread ends was still floating there.

units.source_text: 医生诊断为神经过敏，可是，疑窦不解开，还是一码事。

en.t: The doctor diagnosed it as nervous hypersensitivity, but as long as his doubts were not dispelled, it came to the same thing.
